integrity: The exact law, endpoint classification, and all-N monotonicity are proved in RESULT.md; CHECK.py supplies supplementary exact finite tests and numerical checks, not a replacement for proof. No independent scientific audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms, N >= 3 independent points sampled by normalized boundary arclength; excludes arbitrary quadrilaterals, interior sampling, area variance and full law. Possible unindexed older finite-expectation calculation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact finite-sample area law and rhombus extremizers for boundary-random parallelograms
